title: Network-Miss Credit for Homeowner Service Contracts Households
content:
**Credit schedule — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts, acceptance of a company-elected cash offer.** The network-miss credit recognizes a contractor who missed the window to contact the customer, shown in the assignment record as an assignment re-dispatched after a missed contact window. Accepting the cash closes the claim, so this credit, which Bridgewell owes on the request, is settled in the same payment: it is added to the accepted offer amount as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, before the total is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.

1. **120.00** when an assignment on the request carries the dispatch reason "re-dispatch after a missed contact window" and, within the twelve months before today, the household has already met another missed contact window, counting first an assignment re-dispatched for that reason on another of its Homeowner Service Contracts requests and then one on a request under a Bridgewell line plan the customer holds (Utility Line Protection Plans), so that the miss repeats a failure of Bridgewell's contractor network the household has already met.
2. **75.00** when an assignment on the request carries that dispatch reason and no such earlier re-dispatch exists in that time.
3. **Nothing** when no assignment on the request carries that dispatch reason.

| Missed-contact re-dispatch on this request | Earlier one, last twelve months, other homeowner-contract request | Earlier one, last twelve months, Utility Line Protection Plans request | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | 120.00 |
| yes | no | yes | 120.00 |
| yes | no | no | 75.00 |
| no | any | any | nothing |

The line plan records read are the customer's Utility Line Protection Plans service requests and their contractor assignments. "Within the twelve months before today" means dated after the same calendar day twelve months earlier.
